name: 09 Correspondence — Contact form validation and submission

planSteps.description: Navigate to /contact.html and wait for the correspondence form to load
Verify error messages appear for required fields name, email, type, subject, and message
Click the direction shortcut button for 'Consign an Object'

Fill in '#contact-name' with 'Collector Test', '#contact-email' with 'test@example.com', '#contact-subject' with 'Timepiece Consignment', and '#contact-message' with 'Inquiry regarding vintage watch lot.'
Verify the confirmation message displays 'Your demonstration enquiry has been recorded in this session. No message has been transmitted.'
